# Hand Coded

> Hand Coded is a Barcelona studio that designs and builds interactive, immersive experiences for brands and cultural venues, and the technical workshop behind agencies and artists: light, sound, AI and our own tools.

Creative technology studio based in Barcelona, founded in 2008. Not to be confused with “hand-coded”, the generic term for code written by hand.

## Founders
- [Cyril Laurier](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/en/cyril/): Co-founder. PhD in music AI, Sony CSL researcher.
- [Maya Benaïnous](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/en/maya/): Co-founder. Artist and engineer, creator of Ledotron.

## Expertise
- [Imagine](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/en/imaginer/): Concepts for brands and venues. For a brand, a launch or a venue, we invent the experience: what the audience will see, hear and set off. We write the concept, the device and the way it responds, then we build it all the way to opening day.
- [Explore](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/en/explorer/): Consulting and workshops. You are looking for what is possible before knowing what you want. We bring your teams together, put the constraints on the table, test leads and help you pick the right one, even if it means steering the project elsewhere.
- [Build](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/en/fabriquer/): Development and production. You come with a brief or a concept already written. Real-time software, sensors, light, sound, electronics: we build the device from end to end, and run it on site or on tour. With our network of makers, from a one-off piece to a large-scale installation.
- [Support](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/en/accompagner/): Technical support for agencies and artists. An agency or an artist has the project in mind. We give them the tools to make it exist, from prototype to installation, without taking their place: your idea, your signature, our workshop.
- [Concept design](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/en/concept-design/). We join the brainstorm early, suggest the technologies that serve the idea, and carry it from concept to production.
- [Project management](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/en/project-management/). One team from the first sketch to the last show, for brands and museums alike. We keep to schedules and budgets, from the first proposal to the get-out. Maya set up and ran a 3D animation studio: 104 episodes delivered a week ahead of deadline. Keeping to a schedule is what we do. A far-reaching…
- [Reliability and maintenance](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/en/maintenance/). An installation has to work on the thousandth night as well as the first. We design it to run on its own, and we keep watch over it. Automatic tests, every night and every morning. We developed our own maintenance software. It tests the whole system, restarts it if something goes wrong and, if it…
- [Sustainable thinking](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/en/sustainable/). Sustainable design approaches in the choice of materials, energy and durability of every installation.
- [Machine learning & our own AI](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/en/machine-learning/). Systems that listen, watch and decide: emotion detection in music, real-time choices on stage, recommendation engines.
- [Real-time development](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/en/real-time/). Software that reacts within the frame: custom engines in C++, openFrameworks, OpenGL and shaders, built to run night after night.
- [Audio processing](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/en/audio/). Sound analysis and generation that drive light, image and motion: beat detection, spatialisation, interactive music.
- [Generative animation](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/en/generative/). Algorithms that generate designs and animations, for LEDs, screens and projection.
- [Projection mapping](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/en/projection-mapping/). Projection on architecture, objects and bodies, synchronised with sound and sensors.
- [Light and LED control](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/en/light/). From a few strips to thousands of LEDs and motors, designed and driven with Ledotron, over DMX and Art-Net.
- [Tracking and sensors](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/en/tracking/). Kinect, Leap Motion, cameras, body and brain sensors: we turn people's presence and movement into data.
- [Our tools](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/en/tools/). Autodesk Maya, After Effects, TouchDesigner, Photoshop, Xcode, MadMapper, Millumin, Ableton Live and our own Ledotron. C++, OpenGL, openFrameworks, Objective-C, SceneKit, Python, Max/MSP, GLSL, VST and WebGL. Ledotron, our software for creating and controlling light, can be rented or bought. And…
- [Hardware and protocols](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/en/hardware/). DMX, Art-Net, OSC, Kinect 1 and 2, Leap Motion, augmented reality, iOS, Android and Arduino.
- [Immersive](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/en/immersive/): Rooms of light, sound and data that answer the people inside them.. We design and build immersive spaces where image, light and sound are generated in real time, so the work is never the same twice. Cameras and sensors follow the visitors, live data from the climate, the music or the place feeds the content, and the room becomes a living environment rather than a…

## Studio
- [Cyril Laurier](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/en/cyril/): Co-founder. PhD in music AI, Sony CSL researcher. · Barcelona. His PhD at the Music Technology Group of the Universitat Pompeu Fabra used machine learning to detect emotions in music. Before that, he studied acoustics, signal processing and computer science applied to music at IRCAM (ATIAM master), where he wrote a generative algorithm for automatic music…
- [Maya Benaïnous](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/en/maya/): Co-founder. Artist and engineer, creator of Ledotron. · Barcelona. Artist and engineer, she creates immersive installations at the crossroads of ecology, technology and the senses, and has worked with real-time data since 2008. She invented a new way to work with LEDs: Ledotron. With Cyril, she signs her artworks as Mouawad + Laurier. Trained in mathematics,…
- [Joan Sandoval](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/en/joan-sandoval/): Creative coder and digital artist · Barcelona. A creative coder and digital artist born in Barcelona. An audiovisual systems engineer (Universitat Pompeu Fabra) with a master’s in music and media technologies from Trinity College Dublin, he teaches at Elisava. Light installations, performance and data visualisation. With us: creative coding and…
